description: A threat actor could intercept and modify API calls between the mobile client and API Gateway, potentially compromising game integrity by manipulating game actions, scores, or user data.
Attackers could attempt to bypass Cognito authentication by forging or stealing authentication tokens, potentially gaining unauthorized access to user accounts and game features.
Distributed Denial of Service attacks targeting the CloudFront CDN could prevent users from downloading game assets and affect game availability.
NoSQL injection attacks against DynamoDB queries could lead to unauthorized access to user data or manipulation of game state information.
Vulnerabilities in game logic Lambda functions could be exploited to manipulate game mechanics, enable cheating, or bypass game rules.
Race conditions in leaderboard updates could be exploited to manipulate rankings or create inconsistent game states.
Unauthorized access to Kinesis streams could expose sensitive user behavior and game analytics data.
Inadequate logging of game actions could allow cheating or malicious behavior to go undetected.
